summary_1line: Hanuman reports to Rama the formidable defenses, army, and geography of Lanka while asserting it can be conquered if the ocean is crossed.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman stands before Rama and the monkey chiefs, gesturing as he describes the golden-walled city of Lanka rising from the sea.
The fortified city of Lanka sits atop a rocky mountain surrounded by the ocean, encircled by golden walls and deep crocodile-filled moats.
Massive gates of Lanka guarded by ranks of armed titans while catapults, stones, and spears are piled high along the ramparts.
